title: Braised Confit Parsnips with Crispy French Bread Croutons
description: A hearty side dish featuring tender confit parsnips topped with crispy french bread croutons, perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the cubed parsnip with olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper until evenly coated.
Spread the parsnip mixture on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Meanwhile, toss the French bread cubes with olive oil and a pinch of salt until evenly coated.
Spread the bread cubes on a separate baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
To assemble, place the roasted parsnip on a serving dish and top with crispy French bread croutons.
If desired, sprinkle grated cheese over the top.
